plan: Copy and validate appointment records, initialize the exact public session shape, and centralize session reset.
Validate each action completely before mutation, dispatch accepted actions to small handlers, and build deterministic screens through one helper.
Keep console I/O behind injected source and sink objects; verify both dependencies before invoking either.
mechanisms: Transactional action validation prevents malformed actions from changing session data.
A prompt-to-choices screen factory enforces the exact screen shape and appointment ordering.
In-place session reset preserves the public dictionary while restoring exactly the four required fields.
Dependency injection makes run_once testable with standard-library unittest fakes.
